text: Room opened — goal: creators: Build PACKAGES + enrich tabs + draft elements; every one labeled 'Created by EXCAVA' + tes

name: Forge
text: I propose that we prioritize creating a consistent package design template that all creators can use. By establishing a unified style, we can enhance our brand identity and streamline the creation process, making it easier for everyone to contribute effectively. The trade-off here is that by enforcing a template, we may limit individual creativity in design. However, the benefits of maintaining quality and coherence across our work outweigh this drawback.

name: Vet
text: I'm not convinced that a uniform package design template is the best use of our resources, as it may stifle creativity and limit the ability of individual creators to innovate and experiment with new ideas. A better approach might be to establish a set of guidelines andbest practices that allow for flexibility and autonomy, while still maintaining a cohesive brand identity. To settle this argument, I'd like to see some data on how a uniform template would impact our creation process and overall brand recognition, as well as some examples of successful companies that have taken a similar approach.

name: Forge
text:
I propose we **adopt a minimal package design template with three fixed slots: title, purpose, and creator credit**. This keeps the brand consistent while leaving room for creators to fill in the rest with their own style. The trade-off is that we give up tight control over aesthetics, but we gain faster creation and clearer ownership—every package will still carry the "Created by EXCAVA" mark, so the brand stays visible. This balances structure with freedom, letting creators focus on content rather than reinventing the wheel.

name: Vet
text: I still have concerns that even a minimal template with fixed slots may lead to a cookie-cutter approach, potentially resulting in packages that lack distinctive character and fail to engage our audience. A better alternative might be to establish a flexible framework that provides guidelines for essential elements, while allowing creators to express their unique style and flair. To settle this, I'd like to see some concrete examples of how this minimal template would work in practice, along with feedback from a subset of our creators to ensure it doesn't stifle their innovation.

name: Nova
text: DECISION: We will implement a minimal package design template with three fixed slots for title, purpose, and creator credit, allowing for individual creativity within a consistent brand framework; ownership of the template design will reside with Forge, and it must be ready for testing by the end of the week.
